title: Employment (appointment) letter
description: A plain appointment letter for an employee: role, start date, pay, probation and notice. Statutory benefits, deductions and mandatory terms are left for a lawyer.

fields.label: Notice either side must give to end the employment (months)

clauses.label: Probation period
clauses.text:
Probation
Your first {{probation_months}} month(s) of employment are a probation period, after which the employer will tell you in writing whether you are confirmed. [LAWYER TO CONFIRM: what the employer may do during or at the end of probation]

clauses.label: Keep the employer's information confidential
clauses.text:
Confidentiality
You will keep the employer's confidential business information secret during and after your employment, and use it only for your work.

clauses.label: No other paid work without written consent
clauses.text:
Other work
You will not take other paid work while employed without the employer's written consent.

body:
{{employer_name}}
{{employer_address}}

Date: {{letter_date}}

To: {{employee_name}}
{{employee_address}}

Subject: Letter of appointment

Dear {{employee_name}},

We are pleased to offer you employment on the following terms.

Position
You will work as {{designation}}, reporting to {{reporting_to}}.

Start date and place of work
Your employment starts on {{start_date}}. Your place of work is {{work_location}}.

Pay
Your gross pay is {{monthly_salary}} per month, before any deduction that the law or this letter requires. Pay will be made by bank transfer.

{{clause:probation}}Hours and leave
[LAWYER TO CONFIRM: working hours, weekly off, holidays and leave entitlement that apply]

{{clause:confidentiality}}{{clause:outside_work}}Ending the employment
Either of us may end the employment by giving the other {{notice_months}} month(s) of written notice. [LAWYER TO CONFIRM: whether pay in place of notice, or other exit terms, should be included]

Statutory requirements
[LAWYER TO CONFIRM: any statutory benefits, deductions, registrations and mandatory terms that apply to this employer and this employee]

Please sign and return a copy of this letter to show that you accept these terms.

For {{employer_name}}

______________________
Name and title: ______________________

Acceptance
I accept the terms of this letter.

______________________   Date: ______________
{{employee_name}}
